limits: Tests exercise two backend capture workers, four independent outgoing carriers; not every worker count.
Race instrumentation detects shared Go state races, not every kernel/packet-ring ownership defect.
Finite local virtual link results do not certify universal link quality or thousands of busy production users.
Paced mixed test uses a 1 ms think time and offered 1 Gbit/s in each bulk direction; not an uncapped peak throughput test.
